dataset: CIC-IDS2017, improved release (Engelen et al.), train Monday-Wednesday, test Thursday-Friday

ablation.note: train_on=normal only changes the unsupervised models; rf always sees both classes

protocol.sample: per seed, normal flows capped at 80,000 (train and validation pool) and 40,000 (test), every attack type at 8,000 / 10,000; sampling is part of the seed
protocol.split: 10-minute blocks of Monday-Wednesday go 80% / 20% to train / validation, new assignment per seed; Thursday-Friday is the test set
protocol.novelty: every attack type in the test set is absent from Monday-Wednesday
protocol.labels: '... - Attempted' flows are relabelled benign, as the authors recommend
protocol.features: 82 numeric CICFlowMeter columns; identifiers, ports, time stamp and label columns dropped
protocol.transform: none, or sign(x) * log1p(|x|) on every column (slog1p), applied before scaling
protocol.thresholds: as in evaluate.py: max F1, 1% / 5% false alarms on validation normals, quantiles, oracle
protocol.scaler: fit on the training split only
